Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: PvP cues, Smart Tab, responsive helpers, and survival tools.
Description: A local PvP HUD with nameplate cues, Limit Break alerts, pressure and CC information, Ping Helpers, medicine-kit beacons, range rings, a Wolves' Den map panel, recovery and job helpers, Smart Tab, assist macros, MP sounds, and target highlights.
Changelog: Fixed Smart Action tap-to-land. FFXIV can report an authored macro action as a normal action; Seiton now accepts that form only after the exact Smart Action generation, ability, and visible target are proven. Supported visible-target casts and the hidden-carrier-to-<t> cast fallback now receive the same exact reservation without target changes or auto-facing. Queue mode remains excluded, another action still cancels the wait, and replay keeps the same action and target. Live in-game confirmation remains separate from build checks.
